baseline_prompt_en: A candid editorial photograph inside a tiny neighborhood grocery on a dry, overcast early morning. One adult woman is the focal shopper; use the attached portrait as guidance only for her visible long dark wavy hair parted near the center, dark eyes, and softly contoured face. She wears an olive jacket over a dark shirt and stands beside a shallow wooden produce crate. Her right hand lifts one bright tangerine a few inches above the pile in the crate, while her left hand holds a folded paper shopping list at chest height. A blue wire shopping basket rests on the waist-high counter beside her, with two tangerines visible through its open mesh. The narrow wall of canned goods behind her and a dry sidewalk glimpsed through the front window make the small shop readable as a lived-in place. Amber hanging bulbs warm the fruit while cool gray window light falls across her face. Frame her face, both hands, the lifted fruit, the crate, the list, and the basket in one coherent three-quarter view. Preserve believable hand contact and the ordinary clutter and textures of a working grocery; render as a natural photographic moment with crisp focal details and gently receding shelves.
